chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Muhammad from Sayf from Mansur ibn Hazim said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who threw [the pebbles at the Jamarat] and shaved [his head], does he eat something containing yellow bile (or impurity)? He said: 'No, until he performs Tawaf around the House and Sa'i between Safa and Marwah. Then everything is permissible for him except women, until he performs another Tawaf around the House. Then the women are permissible for him.'
ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for a pilgrim to fully exit Ihram and permit marital relations during Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) delineates the graduated release from Ihram restrictions, emphasizing that while minor prohibitions like eating yellow bile are lifted after Tawaf al-Ifadah and Sa'i, the major prohibition of marital relations remains until the completion of the final Tawaf. This reflects the Shia jurisprudential view that the stages of Hajj rituals correspond to specific legal relaxations, ensuring the pilgrim maintains a state of ritual purity and devotion until the final rites are concluded.
